rules.how: client-side movement with the server checking and charging chakra (ROADMAP)
rules.control: control lengthens wall-runs, lowers per-second costs (x(1.2 - control/250)) and lets you fight while water-walking
rules.combat: staggered while tree-walking or wall-running: you fall; while water-walking: you sink for 20 ticks

movement.name: Roof and tree hopping
movement.effect: a forward boost off leaves, logs and roofs (Beta 1 roof running at night, full hopping in Beta 2)

movement.name: Chakra jump
movement.effect: hold jump to charge, up to 3x height; no fall damage while chakra lasts

movement.name: Tree walking
movement.effect: walk up trunks and walls; control +10 on first mastery

movement.name: Wall-running
movement.effect: along or up a wall for up to 3 s (+1 s at control 60, +2 at 90)

movement.name: Water-walking
movement.effect: stand on water (a mixin on canStandOnFluid); sneak to sink; a hit that staggers you dunks you

movement.name: Air step
movement.effect: a second jump in the air

movement.name: Wind glide
movement.effect: a slow fall with steering, like an elytra at a third of the speed

movement.name: Silent step
movement.effect: footsteps make no noise for the AI's hearing (Tobari: free at night)
